claim: Full transition and integration occurs over 90 days from the start date.
The long-term transition phase spans 12 months from the start date.
The Exit Transition Plan will be developed within 90 days of the Commencement Date.
Exit transition activities begin no later than nine months before the end of the O&M term.
The compliance audit will occur within 30 days of departure and regulatory-reporting support may continue for up to 30 days post-departure.
Tools, spare parts, and consumables will be stocked for at least four weeks post-handover.
JC Solutions may provide up to 180 days of extended support post-exit.
